description: This file defines a set of constants used for bulk import of loan data in the Apache Fineract project. It contains column indices for CSV or spreadsheet data, as well as some string constants for loan types.

classes.name: LoanConstants
classes.description: A utility class containing constant values for column indices and loan type strings used during bulk import operations.
